entries.title: Job 3:1
segments: After this Job opened his mouth and cursed his day.

entries.title: Job 3:2
segments: And Job spoke and said,

entries.title: Job 3:3
segments: Let the day perish in [which] I was born, and the night [which] said, A man-child is conceived.

entries.title: Job 3:4
segments: Let that day be darkness. Let not God look upon it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

entries.title: Job 3:5
segments: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it. Let a cloud dwell upon it; Let the blackness of the day terrify it.

entries.title: Job 3:6
segments: As [for] that night, let darkness seize upon it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year, Let it not come into the number of the months.

entries.title: Job 3:7
segments: Lo, let that night be barren; let no joyful voice come in it.

entries.title: Job 3:8
segments: Let those curse it who curse the day, who are ready to stir up Leviathan.

entries.title: Job 3:9
segments: Let the stars of its twilight be dark; let it look for light, but have none. Let it not see the eyelids of the dawn.

entries.title: Job 3:10
segments: For it did not shut up the doors of my [mother's] womb, nor hide sorrow from my eyes.

entries.title: Job 3:11
segments: Why did I not die from the womb, come from the womb and expire?

entries.title: Job 3:12
segments: Why did the knees go before me; or why the breasts, that I should suck?

entries.title: Job 3:13
segments: For now I should have lain still and been quiet; I should have slept. Then I would have been at rest

entries.title: Job 3:14
segments: with kings and wise men of the earth, who built ruins for themselves,

entries.title: Job 3:15
segments: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

entries.title: Job 3:16
segments: or as a hidden untimely birth I would not have been, like infants who did not see light.

entries.title: Job 3:17
segments: There the wicked cease [from] troubling, and there the weary are at rest;

entries.title: Job 3:18
segments: the prisoners are at rest together; they hear not the voice of the slave driver.

entries.title: Job 3:19
segments: The small and the great are there, and the slave [is] free from his master.

entries.title: Job 3:20
segments: Why is light given to one who is in misery, and life to the bitter [in] soul,

entries.title: Job 3:21
segments: who is waiting for death, but [it] comes not; and dig for it more than [for] treasures?

entries.title: Job 3:22
segments: They are rejoicing to exultation. They are glad when they can find the grave.

entries.title: Job 3:23
segments: To a man whose way is hidden, God has made a hedge about him.

entries.title: Job 3:24
segments: For my sighing comes before I eat, and my groanings are poured out like the waters.

entries.title: Job 3:25
segments: For the thing which I greatly feared has come upon me, and that which I was afraid of has come to me.

entries.title: Job 3:26
segments: I was not in safety, nor did I have rest, nor was I quiet; yet trouble comes.
